summary: [standards] L0.page reports `unsupported` without having observed every listed command refuse `--cursor x`: a command listed without an `ok` invocation whose cursor probe is inconclusive (cursor_verdict Unknown and !cursor_from_ok) is dropped from `verdicts`, so one listed command that refuses `--cursor` as an unknown option is enough. The ATIP author's rule is unsupported only by observing `--cursor x --json` refusals, and a paging tool that omits its paged call is unprovided. Reproduced: fake tool with `items` (pages) listed only under `refused` and answering `items --cursor x --json` with USAGE field `--name` (it needs an operand), plus `team add` (ok, refuses --cursor): L0.page is `unsupported` with the reason `each refuses --cursor as an option it does not have`, which is false for `items`; (that fixture lacks a missingValue, so exit 1 there comes from L0.no-prompt only). The test atip_check_73 only uses a pageable command that needs no operand, so it hits CURSOR_INVALID. Fix: treat an inconclusive probe of any listed command as unprovided (or probe with the command's missingValue/refused argv), and say in the reason which command was inconclusive. Blast radius: only fixtures that list a paging command without an `ok` invocation; canon's own fixture is not affected (L0.page passes there).
